_comment: Ghost imagery plan (chosen 2026-11-15). Source files live outside the repo in ../../UI Inspo/<theme folder>/<file>. Step 3 (V2) converts each to WebP sized for its slot, lazy-loads it, and puts it behind a dark scrim so text stays AA. Credits come from the design doc's credit table; the About screen lists every image used. GILT_EXOTICS stays empty until the exotic review.
